title: Revenant-Plugin: Monitor Suite Implementation
description:
Build the continuous monitoring suite for Revenant-Plugin.

## Objective
Implement continuous monitoring that replaces periodic cron-based monitoring (Stability Monitor, Boredom Scan, ArXiv Monitor, Cron Health Monitor).

## Scope
- Boredom monitor: continuous calculation, threshold triggers
- Stability monitor: memory, CPU, drive health, cron status
- ArXiv monitor: real-time paper detection, auto-download
- Cron health monitor: execution tracking, failure detection
- System health monitor: gateway status, plugin health
- Alert triggers and broadcast to agent sessions

## Guardrails
- WORK ONLY in: D:\.openclaw\workspace-revenants
- NO GitHub pushes or modifications
- NO upstream pushes or modifications to anything outside the local project folder
- NO modifications to existing Remnant-Research repo
- NO modifications to existing cron jobs or OpenClaw config
- All work stays in the designated project workspace directory

- Architecture: D:\.openclaw\workspace-revenants\docs\ARCHITECTURE.md
- Monitor suite design: D:\.openclaw\workspace-revenants\monitors\monitor-suite.md
- Validation plan: D:\.openclaw\workspace-revenants\test\VALIDATION-PLAN.md

## Deliverables
- Monitor suite plugin code (monitors/*.js or equivalent)
- Alert trigger system
- Broadcast to agent sessions
- Documentation in docs/
- Validation test results in test/

## Success Criteria
- Continuous monitoring (no periodic gaps)
- Zero timeout failures
- Zero model token cost
- Immediate alert triggers
- Agent-friendly broadcast payloads
